title: Asian Refiners Ask to Pick Up Saudi Oil Outside Risky Red Sea
summary: Some Asian refiners are pushing back against Saudi Aramco’s request that they pick up their oil at Yanbu on the Red Sea, due to the difficulty of finding ships willing to sail through the dangerous waterway.

title: Dollar Dips as Fed Hike Bets Ease, Treasuries Rise: Markets Wrap
summary: The dollar fell against most of its major peers after weak US economic data reduced bets on a Federal Reserve interest-rate hike next month.

title: FTSE 100 Live: Futures Rise as Stocks Globally Rally
Maniatis: Oman Spill Cleanup May Cost USD 200-500M
summary: Specialists are racing to salvage a sinking shadow-fleet tanker off Oman that has caused a massive oil slick. Personnel have already boarded the Caroline Bezengi, a Suezmax that has grounded off Oman’s southern coast. Dimitris Maniatis, CEO of maritime risk management firm Marisks spoke to Bloomberg’s Abeer Abu Omar on Horizons Middle East & Africa on the short & long-term consequences of such a spill. (Source: Bloomberg)

title: Bonds Sell Off After India Closes Window for Dollar Swaps Early
summary: Shorter-tenor India bond yields surged after the central bank said it will close a special dollar deposit window for overseas residents a month earlier than scheduled.

title: Japan 10-Year Yield Rises to Highest Since 1996 on BOJ Hike Bets
summary: Japan’s bonds fell on fiscal concerns and growing speculation that the Bank of Japan may raise interest rates in the coming months, pushing the 10-year yield to the highest since 1996.

title: L’imad’s Ports Deal Signals Abu Dhabi Wealth Fund’s Growing Role
summary: Abu Dhabi wealth fund L’imad Holding is offering to buy out minority shareholders in the city’s port operator valuing the firm at 31.8 billion dirhams ($8.66 billion), potentially bolstering the emirate’s efforts to build out infrastructure that could help it bypass the Strait of Hormuz.

title: Emerging Currencies Rise to Record High as Fed Hike Bets Ease
summary: Emerging-market currencies rose to a record high as bets on a Federal Reserve interest rate hike cooled, spurring demand for risk assets.

title: A2 Milk Sees Slow Recovery From China Formula Supply Problem
summary: New Zealand infant formula supplier a2 Milk will take 12 months to fully recover from supply chain disruptions that impacted its China sales earlier this year, Chief Executive Officer David Bortolussi said.

title: Copper Surges Toward Record on LME as Scramble for Supply Builds
summary: Copper rose toward a record, with a key spread in London widening to extreme levels in a sign of intense competition for prompt supply.

title: Israel Strikes Lebanon as US Prepares Fresh Iran Sanctions | The Asia Trade 8/17/2026
summary: "Bloomberg: The Asia Trade" brings you everything you need to know to get ahead as the trading day begins in Asia. Bloomberg TV is live from Sydney with Haidi Stroud-Watts and Paul Allen, getting insight and analysis from newsmakers and industry leaders on the biggest stories shaping global markets. (Source: Bloomberg)

title: Latest Oil Market News and Analysis for June 17
summary: Oil fluctuated as fresh fighting in Lebanon and attacks on vessels in the Strait of Hormuz muddied the outlook for a deal to end the US-Iran war.

title: LimX on China's Robotics Development
summary: Jesse Liu, CFO at Chinese robotics firm LimX Dynamics, says China' robotics industry is working toward bridging itself with frontier findings in academia. But he tells "Bloomberg: The China Show" that LimX has demonstrated "exponential potential" for scaling up. (Source: Bloomberg)

title: South Africa to Finalize Rules for $9.3 Trillion OTC Derivatives Market by 2028
summary: South Africa’s financial regulators plan to finalize new rules requiring over-the-counter derivatives to be centrally cleared in the next two years to improve transparency and reduce risk.

title: Sri Lankan Inflation to Come Down: Central Bank Head
summary: Sri Lankan inflation will likely slow back toward the central bank’s target over the second half of this year and into next year, central bank Governor Nandalal Weerasinghe tells Bloomberg Television in Sydney. He adds that changes to oil prices remain a risk factor in projections. (Source: Bloomberg)

title: Sembcorp Said to Plan Filing for $500 Million IPO of India Unit
summary: Singapore-based Sembcorp Industries Ltd. is preparing to file for an initial public offering of its Indian unit, Sembcorp Green Infra Ltd., that could raise as much as $500 million, according to people familiar with the matter.

title: Anwar Avoids Coalition Turmoil as Key Party Stays in Cabinet
summary: Malaysia’s Prime Minister Anwar Ibrahim won a rare political reprieve over the weekend, after a string of electoral setbacks and turmoil within his own party, as the biggest component of his ruling coalition voted to stay in cabinet.

title: First Gen Falls by Record 19% After Parent Rejected KKR Offer
summary: Shares of First Gen Corp., one of the Philippines’ largest renewable energy companies, fell by a record on Monday after its parent turned down an offer from KKR to buy additional shares and take it private.

title: BlueScope's Archibald: Focused on Organic Growth
summary: BlueScope Steel MD and CEO Tania Archibald says her company is very much focused on organic growth and intends to improve shareholder returns over an extended period. She speaks with Yvonne Man and David Ingles on "Bloomberg: The China Show." (Source: Bloomberg)

title: Xi Ties Predecessor’s Legacy to His Agenda as Global Risks Rise
summary: Chinese President Xi Jinping invoked the legacy of his predecessor Jiang Zemin to advance his own economic and global policy agenda, warning of “high winds and rough waters” as China faces slowing growth and rising tensions abroad.
